counterexamples: Order, the limit and the reported length are unchanged; only the removal cost at the front of the buffer changes.

tempting_allegations.allegation: drain checks the buffer and then pops without a lock, so two threads can race.
tempting_allegations.evidence: task_queue.py module docstring in both revisions; worker.py next_batch, submit and pending.
tempting_allegations.why_wrong: The buffer was equally unsynchronized before the change, its public docstring assigns locking to the owner, and the only owner (worker.py) holds its lock around every call.
